name: open-game-assets
description: Match open-licensed game assets to reproducible test-fixture requirements with license and integrity evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Match open game assets to reproducible tests.
interface.longDescription: Find suitable open-licensed 2D, 3D, audio, VFX, material, HDRI and animation assets for game tests; preserve source, license, edition and byte-integrity evidence; and keep missing runtime validation explicit.
defaultPrompt: Find suitable open-licensed assets for this game test and explain what still needs runtime validation.
Prepare reproducible 2D, 3D, audio, or VFX fixtures for this test, preferring verified local assets first.
Check whether my existing fixture lock still satisfies this test before suggesting a new download.
